verdicts.reason: Both use the same skyscraper layout. The coffee bag, the original's hero image, is shrunk to a small thumbnail and sits beside a logo roundel of the same size, so the brand mark competes with the product. The SAVE 15% badge is jammed near the top edge, and the headline's orphan 'on' line makes it read choppily. A clusters the copy and CTA right under the thumbnails and leaves about 60px of dead space at the bottom. B spreads the elements down to a bottom margin that roughly matches the top margin, though it opens a mid-canvas gap above the body copy, so B is marginally better balanced.
